title: Suggest related items once, when a Reference is created or changes, and never on a schedule
description: Ryan, 2026-11-04: 'We should do ONE check for related items when a Reference is created, and possibly when it's updated, but we should never just keep redoing it over and over and over.' The hourly suggest-backlog schedules were disabled by hand on 2026-11-04 (drift until the template changes). Measured on Machines on Machines: one run wrote 7,153 suggestions, S3 Vectors reached 72,621 requests on 11-03, and later hourly runs wrote nothing while re-reading References to plan.
